policy: Provisional component-family naming sensitivity. These pairs are accepted only as the first child of a horizontal layout at any depth. They are not assertions of visual identity or image-specific correctness. No transitive closure or expansion is applied.

sources.title: The Unicode Standard, Version 17.0, Section 18.1: Han; Radical-Stroke Indices
sources.limitation: The standard describes radical families and glyph variation; it does not prescribe these IDS matching rules.

sources.title: Unicode Han Database, kRSUnicode
sources.limitation: Radical-stroke classification does not establish visual interchangeability.
